title: Alibaba Super Cup Launches! Qwen3.8-Max Officially Released, Programming and Office Capabilities Fully Upgraded

content_html:
Alibaba recently officially launched the new generation foundation large model Qwen3.8-Max, with a total of 2.4 trillion parameters. As another important achievement in the field of artificial intelligence, the model has achieved significant improvements in performance in core scenarios such as programming and professional office work, demonstrating strong technical capabilities.

In the authoritative third-party large model ranking list Arena, the newly released Qwen3.8-Max performed outstandingly, ranking second only to the Claude series from Anthropic, and is among the industry's top performers. This breakthrough not only reflects the significant progress of domestic large models in handling complex tasks, but also provides developers and enterprise users with higher-level intelligent tools.

Currently, the API interface of this model has been officially launched on the Qwen AI platform and has been integrated into the newly launched "Qwen Office" Agent product. In addition, to further promote the development of the open-source ecosystem and technology sharing, Alibaba officially announced that the Qwen3.8-Max and Qwen3.8-27B models are expected to be officially open-sourced next week.

content_html_zh:
阿里巴巴近日正式推出新一代基础大模型Qwen3.8-Max，参数总数达2.4万亿。 作为人工智能领域的又一重要成果，该模型在编程、专业办公等核心场景上实现了性能显着提升，展现了强大的技术能力。

在权威第三方大型模型排行榜Arena中，新发布的Qwen3.8-Max表现出色，排名仅次于Anthropic的Claude系列，跻身行业前列。 这一突破不仅体现了国产大型模型在处理复杂任务方面的显着进步，也为开发者和企业用户提供了更高水平的智能工具。

目前，该模型的API接口已在Qwen AI平台上正式上线，并已集成到新推出的“Qwen Office”Agent产品中。 此外，为进一步推动开源生态发展和技术共享，阿里巴巴正式宣布Qwen3.8-Max和Qwen3.8-27B型号预计将于下周正式开源。
